paperl10n-app-name: The app's name. Usually not translated.
paperl10n-open-folder: Button that shows the folder picker to open a project. The ellipsis means a dialog follows.
paperl10n-opening: Replaces {{msg-paperl10n|paperl10n-open-folder}} while a project is opening.
paperl10n-empty-state: Shown before any project is open.
paperl10n-interface-language: Label of the selector for the language of the app itself (not of the project).
paperl10n-project-format: Tooltip on the format name in the header's project chip. $1: the format plugin's name, e.g. "VitePress".
paperl10n-source-pane: Heading of the source pane. $1: the source language's own name, e.g. "English".
paperl10n-target-pane: Heading of the translation pane. $1: the target language's own name, e.g. "עברית".
paperl10n-documents-count: Number of source documents. $1: the number.
paperl10n-no-documents: Shown when the open project has no source documents.
paperl10n-config-warnings: Heading above a list of non-fatal notes about the project's config file (each note is shown in English for now).
paperl10n-error-workspace-folder-unavail: Error. $1: the reason code: not-found, not-a-folder, or unreadable.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-missing: Error when the chosen folder has no config file. "paperl10n.config.json" is a file name: don't translate it.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-unreada: Error. $1: the config file's path; $2: the problem code.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-invalid: Heading above a list of problems in the config file (each problem is shown in English for now).
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-docume: Error. $1: the plugin id written in the config file.
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-catalo: Error. $1: the plugin id written in the config file. A catalog format reads a project's interface messages (such as banana-i18n).
paperl10n-error-workspace-no-format: Error. "documentFormat" and "catalogFormat" are config keys: don't translate them.
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-projec: Error when the app no longer knows the project the UI refers to.
paperl10n-error-formats-invalid-options: Error. $1: the plugin id; $2: the plugin's explanation (in English).
paperl10n-error-formats-unsupported-proj: Error. $1: the plugin id; $2: the plugin's explanation (in English).
paperl10n-error-formats-invalid-catalog: Error when a catalog file (interface messages) isn't valid for its format. $1: the plugin id; $2: the plugin's explanation (in English).
paperl10n-error-formats-file-access: Error. $1: the plugin id; $2: the file's path; $3: the problem code.
paperl10n-error-formats-plugin-failed: Error when a plugin crashed (a bug in the plugin). $1: the plugin id; $2: technical details.
paperl10n-error-internal-unexpected: Error for a bug in the app itself.
paperl10n-error-internal-invalid-request: Error for a malformed request between the app's own parts (a bug).
paperl10n-theme: Accessible name of the group of theme choices (color scheme of the app).
paperl10n-theme-system: Theme choice: follow the operating system's light or dark setting. Shown as a tooltip and read by screen readers.
paperl10n-theme-light: Theme choice: always use the light color scheme.
paperl10n-theme-dark: Theme choice: always use the dark color scheme.
paperl10n-welcome-title: Title of the welcome screen, shown before any project is open.
paperl10n-language-pair: Read by screen readers for the language pair in the header (shown visually as "English → עברית"). $1: the source language's own name; $2: the target language's own name.
paperl10n-pages: Heading and accessible name of the sidebar that lists the project's pages (documents).
paperl10n-find-page: Accessible label of the search box that filters the list of pages.
paperl10n-find-page-placeholder: Placeholder text in the page search box: what you can search by.
paperl10n-pages-matching: Shown while searching pages. $1: the number of pages that match; $2: the number of pages in total.
paperl10n-no-matching-pages: Shown when no page matches the search. $1: what the user typed.
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-docume: Error when the chosen page is no longer among the project's documents. $1: the page's key, e.g. "guide/intro".
paperl10n-error-workspace-document-unrea: Error when a page's file can't be read. $1: the file's path; $2: the problem code, e.g. files.not-utf8.
paperl10n-reading: Shown in a pane while its file is being read.
paperl10n-translation-missing: Shown in the translation pane when the page has no translation file yet.
paperl10n-status-missing: Status of a page with no translation file yet. Read by screen readers in the page list, and shown in the legend.
paperl10n-status-draft: Status of a page whose translation exists but was never marked up to date (or only some of its sections were). "Marked up to date" means the translator said the translation matches its source. Read by screen readers in the page list, shown in the legend and the page header.
paperl10n-status-translated: Status of a page (or section) marked up to date, whose source hasn't changed since. Read by screen readers in the page list, shown in the legend and the page header.
paperl10n-status-outdated: Status of a page (or section) marked up to date once, whose source changed since: the translation may need updating. Read by screen readers in the page list, shown in the legend and the page header.
paperl10n-pages-up-to-date: Above the list of pages. $1: how many pages are marked up to date with an unchanged source; $2: how many pages there are.
paperl10n-pages-outdated: Above the list of pages, when some are outdated (their source changed since they were marked up to date). $1: how many.
paperl10n-sidebar: Accessible name of the sidebar that lists what the project has to translate: its pages, its message catalogs, or both.
paperl10n-messages: Heading of the sidebar group that lists the project's message catalogs (files of interface messages, such as banana-i18n's).
paperl10n-catalogs-count: Number of message catalogs, beside the "Messages" heading. $1: the number.
paperl10n-no-catalogs: Shown in the "Messages" group when the project has a catalog format but no catalogs were found.
paperl10n-catalog-up-to-date: Under a catalog's name in the sidebar. $1: how many of its messages are up to date; $2: how many messages its source has.
paperl10n-catalog-outdated: After a catalog's progress, when some of its messages are outdated (their source changed since they were translated). $1: how many.
paperl10n-messages-up-to-date: At the top of the sidebar, for a project with message catalogs and no pages. $1: how many messages are up to date; $2: how many there are, in every catalog.
paperl10n-progress-both: At the top of the sidebar, for a project with both pages and message catalogs. $1: pages up to date; $2: pages; $3: messages up to date; $4: messages.
paperl10n-mark-existing-prompt: Shown once in the page list for a project translated before Paper Lion: none of its translations has been marked up to date yet. $1: how many pages have a translation file.
paperl10n-mark-existing: Button under paperl10n-mark-existing-prompt: marks every existing translation up to date with its source as it is now.
paperl10n-mark-existing-later: Button under paperl10n-mark-existing-prompt: hides the offer until the project is opened again.
paperl10n-mark-existing-done: Confirmation after paperl10n-mark-existing. $1: how many pages were marked up to date.
paperl10n-sections-progress: In the page header: how many of the page's sections are up to date. $1: up to date; $2: all of them.
paperl10n-mark-page: Button in the page header: says the whole translation matches its source as shown, now (recorded in the project's status file right away, not on save).
paperl10n-mark-section: Button in a section's status bar, at its heading in the section view: says this section's translation matches its source as shown, now.
paperl10n-mark-section-name: Accessible name of paperl10n-mark-section, read by screen readers. $1: the section's number on the page; $2: how many sections the page has.
paperl10n-source-changed: In the source pane's section view, at the heading of a section whose source text changed since its translation was last marked up to date (a block changed, was added, or was removed).
paperl10n-source-removed: A thin marker in the source pane, between blocks, where source text that was there when the translation was marked up to date has since been removed. Only its place is known, not the old wording.
paperl10n-source-changes-note: Note in the page's status row, shown when the source changed since the translation was marked up to date: changed and new blocks are tinted in the source pane, and removed text is marked where it was.
paperl10n-hint-missing-code-block: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the source has more of these than the translation. $1: how many; a fenced or indented code block; $2 lists their languages.
paperl10n-hint-extra-code-block: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the translation ("here") has more of these than the source. $1: how many; a fenced or indented code block; $2 lists their languages.
paperl10n-hint-missing-link: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the source has more of these than the translation. $1: how many; a link; $2 lists their targets (the translation's read in the source's form).
paperl10n-hint-extra-link: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the translation ("here") has more of these than the source. $1: how many; a link; $2 lists their targets (the translation's read in the source's form).
paperl10n-hint-missing-image: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the source has more of these than the translation. $1: how many; an image; $2 lists their file paths or URLs.
paperl10n-hint-extra-image: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the translation ("here") has more of these than the source. $1: how many; an image; $2 lists their file paths or URLs.
paperl10n-hint-missing-component: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the source has more of these than the translation. $1: how many; an MDX component or HTML tag; $2 lists their names.
paperl10n-hint-extra-component: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the translation ("here") has more of these than the source. $1: how many; an MDX component or HTML tag; $2 lists their names.
paperl10n-hint-missing-frontmatter-key: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the source has more of these than the translation. $1: how many; a top-level key in the frontmatter (the metadata block at the top); $2 lists their names.
paperl10n-hint-extra-frontmatter-key: A preservation hint (a neutral note, not an error): the translation ("here") has more of these than the source. $1: how many; a top-level key in the frontmatter (the metadata block at the top); $2 lists their names.
paperl10n-hint-no-language: In a preservation hint about code blocks, stands for a code block written without a language name.
paperl10n-hint-separator: Between the values a preservation hint lists (link targets, names).
paperl10n-hints-title: Heading above the page's preservation hints, in the translation pane: neutral notes about things (links, code blocks, images, components, frontmatter keys) a translation usually keeps as is, which the translation and its source don't have the same of.
paperl10n-length-note: In the translation pane's header: how long the translation is compared with its source, as rendered (characters, without Markdown syntax or code). $1: the percentage, rounded to 5. Information only.
paperl10n-reopen-page: Button next to an error when marking up to date failed because the source changed on disk: reads the page again (asking first about unsaved changes).
paperl10n-error-workspace-no-target-loca: Error when the UI asks for pages before the project has a translation (target) language.
paperl10n-error-workspace-unknown-langua: Error when the chosen language isn't in Paper Lion's language list or the project's config. $1: the language code, e.g. "xx-foo". "languages" and "paperl10n.config.json" are code: don't translate them.
paperl10n-error-workspace-target-is-sour: Error when the chosen translation language is the project's source language. $1: the language code, e.g. "en".
paperl10n-needs-target: Shown when an opened project has no translation (target) language yet, next to a button that opens the language picker. "paperl10n.config.json" is a file name: don't translate it.
paperl10n-error-workspace-config-unwrita: Error when saving a change to the config file fails. $1: the file name; $2: a technical problem code, e.g. "files.unwritable".
paperl10n-choose-target: Title of the translation-language picker, and the button that opens it when the project has no translation language yet.
paperl10n-change-target: Accessible label of the header button showing the translation language. $1: the language's own name, e.g. "עברית".
paperl10n-language-search: Accessible label of the search box in the language picker.
paperl10n-language-search-placeholder: Placeholder of the language picker's search box: languages can be found by their own name, their name in the interface language, their English name, or their code.
paperl10n-languages: Accessible label of the list of languages in the language picker.
paperl10n-languages-in-project: Language picker section: languages the project already has.
paperl10n-languages-recent: Language picker section: languages the user chose recently.
paperl10n-languages-suggested: Language picker section: English, the computer's languages, and languages spoken in the user's region.
paperl10n-languages-count: Announced to screen readers: how many languages the picker shows. $1: the number.
paperl10n-no-matching-languages: Shown when no language matches the search. $1: what the user typed. "languages" and "paperl10n.config.json" are code: don't translate them.
paperl10n-language-current: Read by screen readers after the language that is the current translation language.
paperl10n-cancel: Button that closes a dialog without changing anything.
paperl10n-error-workspace-document-chang: Error when saving a translation that someone or something else (git, another editor) changed on disk after editing started. $1: the file's path.
paperl10n-error-workspace-document-unwri: Error when writing a translation file fails. $1: the file's path; $2: a technical problem code, e.g. "files.unwritable".
paperl10n-start-translating: Button in the translation pane of a page with no translation file. It opens an editor with a copy of the source text; the file is created when the user saves.
paperl10n-new-translation: Note above the editor of a new translation, before its first save. $1: the file path that saving creates (shown isolated, left to right).
paperl10n-save: Button that saves the translation to its file (also Ctrl+S, or Cmd+S on macOS).
paperl10n-save-status-unsaved: Status next to the Save button: the translation has changes that aren't in the file yet.
paperl10n-save-status-saving: Status next to the Save button while the file is being written.
paperl10n-save-status-saved: Status next to the Save button right after a successful save, until the next edit.
paperl10n-status-unsaved: Status of the open page in the page list when its translation has unsaved changes. Read by screen readers, and shown in the legend while some page has them.
paperl10n-unsaved-title: Title of the dialog shown before leaving a page (switching pages, opening another project, changing the language, closing the window) whose translation has unsaved changes.
paperl10n-unsaved-message: Body of the unsaved-changes dialog. $1: the page key, like guide/getting-started (shown isolated).
paperl10n-discard-changes: Button in the unsaved-changes dialog: leave the page and drop the unsaved changes.
paperl10n-error-workspace-draft-unwritab: Shown when Paper Lion can't write a draft (unsaved edits it keeps in its own data folder, to restore after a crash or restart). The edits are still in the editor.
paperl10n-error-workspace-source-changed: Error when marking a page up to date after its source file changed on disk (git pull, another editor) since the page opened. "Marked up to date" means the translator says the translation matches the source. $1: the source file's path.
paperl10n-error-workspace-status-unreada: Error when the status file (where Paper Lion records which translations are up to date, one per language, in the project) can't be read. $1: the file's path; $2: a technical problem code, e.g. files.not-utf8.
paperl10n-error-workspace-status-invalid: Error when the status file (where Paper Lion records which translations are up to date) isn't valid JSON of the expected shape, e.g. after a git merge conflict. Shown in the page list. $1: the file's path. A technical detail line follows.
paperl10n-error-workspace-status-unsuppo: Error when the status file was written by a newer version of Paper Lion. $1: the file's path; $2: the file's format version, a number.
paperl10n-error-workspace-status-unwrita: Error when writing the status file fails while marking translations up to date. $1: the file's path; $2: a technical problem code, e.g. files.unwritable.
paperl10n-error-workspace-catalog-unread: Error when a file of interface messages (a catalog) can't be read. $1: the file's path; $2: a technical problem code, e.g. files.not-utf8.
paperl10n-draft-restored: Note above the translation editor when a page opens with a draft: unsaved edits Paper Lion kept from an earlier session (or before a crash). Shown until they're saved or discarded.
paperl10n-discard-draft: Button next to the restored-changes note: drops the restored unsaved changes, so the editor shows the file as it is.
paperl10n-draft-restored-changed: Note above the translation editor when a page opens with a draft (see paperl10n-draft-restored) and the file changed on disk after the draft was started. Saving will then show the conflict dialog.
paperl10n-conflict-title: Title of the dialog shown when saving finds that the translation's file was changed on disk (by git, another editor) since editing started.
paperl10n-conflict-message: Body of the conflict dialog. $1: the translation file's path, like he/guide/intro.md (shown isolated). Mentions the two ways out: paperl10n-conflict-reload and paperl10n-conflict-overwrite.
paperl10n-conflict-keep-editing: Button in the conflict dialog (the default): close it and keep the changes unsaved in the editor.
paperl10n-conflict-reload: Button in the conflict dialog: drop the unsaved changes and show the file as it is on disk now.
paperl10n-conflict-overwrite: Button in the conflict dialog: replace the file on disk with the changes in the editor, losing the other change.
paperl10n-link-target: Accessible name of the small link icon the editor shows after a link's text, in place of its hidden Markdown. $1: the link's target (a URL or a path), shown as written.
paperl10n-link-edit: Title of the dialog that edits a link in the translation (its text and its target), opened by clicking a link's icon or with Ctrl+K.
paperl10n-link-add: Title of the link dialog when it makes a new link (from the selected text, or at the caret), opened with Ctrl+K.
paperl10n-link-text: Label of the link dialog's field for the link's text, as it reads in the page (in the page's language).
paperl10n-link-url: Label of the link dialog's field for where the link goes: a web address or a path in the site.
paperl10n-link-apply: Button in the link dialog that writes the changed text and target into the link.
paperl10n-link-add-apply: Button in the link dialog that writes the new link into the text.
paperl10n-link-remove: Button in the link dialog that removes the link but keeps its text in the page.
paperl10n-view-label: Accessible name of the pair of buttons above a page that choose how it is shown: section by section, or as the full page.
paperl10n-view-sections: Toggle button: show the page section by section, each source section beside its translation (sections split at headings).
paperl10n-view-full: Toggle button: show the source and the translation as whole pages, side by side.
paperl10n-scroll-together: Toggle button, shown in the full-page view in a wide window: when pressed (the default), scrolling one pane scrolls the other too, keeping paired section headings level and, between them, the same relative place. A navigation aid only.
paperl10n-sections-unpaired-count: Note above a page that opened as the full page because its translation has a different number of sections than its source. $1: the number of sections in the translation. $2: the number in the source. Sections are the parts of a page between its headings of one level. Paper Lion pairs them again when the page is opened and they match.
paperl10n-sections-unpaired-level: Note above a page that opened as the full page because the translation's headings are at another level than the source's (for example ### where the source has ##), or it has none.
paperl10n-sections-changed: Note above a page in the section view after the translation gained or lost a section heading while editing (or its draft was discarded). The view stays as it is; sections are paired again when the page is opened again.
